title: RBI defers 52-character UTI framework for OTC derivatives to January 2027
summary: RBI deferred Unique Transaction Identifier (UTI) mandate for OTC interest rate, FX, and credit derivatives from April 2026 to January 1, 2027; reported to CCIL.
